title: Print every number
description: Write a function `print_all(numbers)` that prints every number in the list `numbers`, one per line, and also returns None (this exercise is about the loop, not the return value).
hints: You need a `for` loop that goes through every item in `numbers`.
Inside the loop body, call print() on the current item.
expected_behavior: Prints each number on its own line, nothing else.
explanation: A `for` loop repeats its body once per item in the list, automatically stopping when it reaches the end — no manual counting required.
